tier_rules.A: Strong ICP + relevant senior role + strong event evidence. Core segment (metal, food, distribution, logistics) with a P2P, O2C or supply chain leader at Head level or above, named as a speaker. Manufacturing qualifies only at the top: VP or C-level, DACH-based, named by the organiser.
tier_rules.B: Good company or role fit, but a weaker buying signal or weaker evidence: company-level presence only, adjacent or junior role, manufacturing below the A bar, or retail.
tier_rules.C: Weak ICP fit or low relevance: outside target segments, or no buying-relevant function in the published title.

events.name: EuroBLECH 2026
events.audience: Sheet metal processors, steel service centres and metal distributors
events.why: Core vertical. Metal distribution and processing is where GeneralMind's reference customer Kloeckner Metals sits; supplier order confirmations in this sector still run over email and PDF.
events.evidence_summary: Exhibiting companies confirmed on their own websites. Buyers attend as visitors, who are never published.

events.name: BVL Supply Chain CX 2026
events.audience: Supply chain and logistics decision makers, about 2,500 participants
events.why: Germany's main supply chain congress, in GeneralMind's home city. Strong shipper-side operations audience.
events.evidence_summary: Named speakers from a third-party listing of the official programme. Verify against the BVL agenda before outreach.

events.name: European Manufacturing & Supply Chain Summit
events.audience: About 300 senior manufacturing, supply chain and procurement leaders
events.why: Small, senior, manufacturer-heavy room with food and beverage companies on stage (Mondelez, AGRANA), matching the Oatly reference.
events.evidence_summary: Named featured speakers from a third-party listing. Full delegate list is sold by the organiser.

events.name: LogiPharma Digital Supply Chain Connect
events.audience: Senior pharma supply chain and digital transformation leaders
events.why: Tiny, senior and focused on AI-enabled operations. Pharma manufacturers run high-volume, compliance-heavy order flows across ERP and email.
events.evidence_summary: Speaking companies named by the organiser; individual speakers not named yet.

events.name: Fi Europe 2026
events.audience: 1,500+ food ingredient manufacturers and distributors; food producers' purchasing and production teams
events.why: Core vertical. Unlike most fairs, the exhibitors here are themselves buyers: ingredient makers and distributors with heavy Order-to-Cash volume.
events.evidence_summary: Exhibiting companies confirmed on their own websites, with stand numbers.

events.name: BME Symposium Einkauf & Logistik
events.audience: CPOs and procurement leaders from German industry
events.why: The procurement event in DACH, in Berlin. Procure-to-Pay (PO follow-up, 4-way match, AP) is half of GeneralMind's product and this room owns that budget.
events.evidence_summary: Named speakers with titles in the organiser's own programme PDF.

events.name: EUROMETAL Steel Trade Day 2026
events.audience: European steel distributors, service centres and traders
events.why: Core vertical and the closest Kloeckner Metals lookalike room in Europe: the steel distribution association's own meeting.
events.evidence_summary: Named speakers on the organiser's page; more to be announced.

events.name: DSAG Technologietage 2027
events.audience: SAP customers: IT, architecture and process owners
events.why: GeneralMind writes into SAP and other ERPs. SAP process owners are the technical buyers and integration gatekeepers.
events.evidence_summary: No names yet. Ticket sales opened 6 Oct 2026; customer case-study speakers usually appear about 8 weeks before.

events.name: Swiss Supply Chain & Logistics Conference
events.audience: Cross-industry supply chain leaders in Switzerland
events.why: The 2027 theme is turning AI ambition into operational reality: exactly GeneralMind's pitch, in a DACH market.
events.evidence_summary: Programme theme published; speakers not named yet.

events.name: European Procurement & Supply Chain Excellence Summit
events.audience: European CPOs and supply chain heads
events.why: International procurement leaders in Berlin, with a large speaker list published six months ahead.
events.evidence_summary: Named speakers on the organiser's 2027 page. The page intro still mentions 2026, so confirm each name is on the 2027 programme before outreach.
